baseline_exempt_reason: the guard must never fire in production, so its proof is the main loop still completing cycles (and placing orders) after deploy; the reversal is any 'real Alpaca TradingClient refused' line in a production log
expected_rate: every main-loop cycle (5 min in RTH)
window_reason: a false positive would stop all broker calls on the first cycle; one session is enough to see it
reversal: any 'real Alpaca TradingClient refused' in logs/mtf_bot.log or the Day-tier runner log; no orders placed by any tier on a normal session
